reason: I check Google and Trustpilot before I ring anyone, and there's nothing to check here: no clients, no reviews, no UK address. I'm not handing 50% up front to a company in Kuwait I can't look up.
objection: They're in Kuwait, not Manchester. If they take my deposit and go quiet, I've got no review trail, no local office and no easy way to chase them.
would_change_my_mind: A handful of real, checkable reviews from UK businesses on Google or Trustpilot, plus a smaller first payment so I'm not risking half up front.
